$comment: Proposed additive caller-cancellation contract for single-day cn_a 5m orders-mode research. Non-null orders[].order_id or cancel_schedule selects v1.4; missing/null fields retain the earlier contracts. Caller cancellation precedes matching at the same discrete bar-end label, stops future fills as pending_cancel, and is confirmed by the existing end-of-day settlement. This is not a broker, streaming session or venue ACK model. Order ids come from the existing lifecycle owner. Fills, rejections and canceled residuals carry their order_id; cancel_results reports each scheduled request at its model time, while order_states reports final states. The received state hash continues to exclude orders and includes the new cancel_schedule non-order parameter (an empty array for an id-only call). The engine fingerprint covers the same schedule. The v1.1/v1.2/v1.3 artifacts, fee defaults and frozen reason vocabularies are unchanged. The runtime validator supports a keyword subset; a standard draft-2020-12 validator may also consume this artifact.

received_state_hash.$comment: sha256(JCS(non-order inputs)); v1.4 adds cancel_schedule, including [] for an id-only call. Orders and their ids remain excluded. The raw account_state is covered, not its parsed reconstruction.

effective_fee_model.$comment: Full echo of the fee parameters in effect (R7-3). Default key names FROZEN per APPROVAL note 5 / REQUIREMENTS §4 (state_hash.py _DEFAULT_FEE_MODELS, delivery note #7): cn_a = commission_rate 0.00025, commission_min 5.0, stamp_tax_sell 0.0005, transfer_fee 0.00001; hk = commission_rate 0.0003, commission_min 3.0, stamp_tax_rate 0.001, regulatory_levy_rate 0.00003; us = commission_per_share 0.0049, commission_min 0.99, sec_fee_rate 0.0. Per-key merge: RM always injects fee_model explicitly (AM-4-3) and injected keys pass through, so the object stays open by design.

reason.$comment: VD-15: orders mode = empty string; strategy_path mode = strategy reason text truncated to <=200 chars (UTF-8 safe)

reason_code.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (11) — FROZEN, unchanged by pt-v1.2 (D2): the emergency-cancel event lives in canceled_orders, never here
v1.4 caller cancellation plus existing failed-match and volume-cap residual tokens; frozen rejection codes are not extended.

canceled_orders.$comment: Canceled residuals, linked to their order and never including already executed quantity.

event_type.$comment: Session facts (T4, D2). halted = calendar says open, the 5m fetch succeeded, another symbol has bars that day, and this symbol has zero bars for the session (D6).

events.$comment: Existing session facts and their vocabulary are unchanged.

reason.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (2): non_trading_day = cn_a only (CH calendar truth); market_closed_inferred = hk/us only, always accompanied by a warning (AM-6)

warnings.$comment: deterministic English strings, never contain timestamps (VD-7 / R1 hard semantics 1)

source.$comment: AM-9 merged-frame form for cn_a, e.g. 'clickhouse+tencent(merged)'

ratio.$comment: clean hit = ratio label (e.g. '4:1'); unresolved = the observed close-to-close ratio as a decimal string (fail-closed fact, never a guess)

detected.$comment: true = clean split applied; false = unresolved fail-closed rejection (corporate_action_unresolved). Typed to match the T4 emitter (corporate_actions.py); reconciled from the draft's string typing at G1 finalization as its module docstring assigned to T5

limit_provenance.$comment: VD-11 cn_a limit/ST/suspension path tokens, '<symbol>@<date>:<token>' — token set frozen (limits_cn_a.py): limits:stk_limit / limits:heuristic / limits:unavailable / st:stk_st_daily / st:stk_st_daily-no-row / suspend:stk_suspend / suspend:stk_suspend-no-row / limit_list:stk_limit_list_d. Present only for cn_a runs that consulted the band seam

data_provenance.$comment: Extension set FINALIZED at G1 (was draft-open): AM-9 merge-state fields (ch_as_of/network_as_of/bars_as_of), T4 corporate_actions, VD-11 limit_provenance. Optional fields are omitted when unset, never null. Unchanged by pt-v1.2/pt-v1.3.

engine_fingerprint.$comment: sha256(JCS(engine model parameters and served-bar fingerprint)), including the v1.4 cancel schedule and the v1.3 ratio when volume_share is selected. No clock is read.

order_id.$comment: Engine order id (e.g. 'pt-9'), reused verbatim so a caller can reconcile the row with its submitted order.

status.$comment: JoinQuant OrderStatus vocabulary: 'filled' = partially filled and still active; 'held' = fully filled and terminal; 'canceled'/'rejected' are terminal too. A residual canceled by the per-order volume cap reports 'canceled'.

add_time.$comment: Pinned to the cn_a session open: 'YYYY-MM-DDT09:30:00+08:00'.

amount.$comment: Requested order quantity (never the executed quantity).

filled.$comment: Executed quantity so far; 0 when the order never filled and less than amount for a partial.

price.$comment: Average fill price; 0.0 when nothing filled.

order_states.$comment: Final lifecycle states in caller submission order; exactly the existing seven fields, with caller ids honoured and pending cancellation settled by day end.

cancel_results.$comment: Chronological request receipts; ties preserve schedule input order. Pending is observed at request time, not confused with the final order state.

code.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (2 + transport reserved): PAPER_DATA_NOT_READY = retryable (RM 30min x 3); INVALID_REQUEST = non-retryable. Transport-level MCP errors are reserved for engine-internal faults. Unchanged by pt-v1.2.

account_id.$comment: verbatim echo even on the error path (AM-4-4/AM-5)

received_state_hash.$comment: present only when the received account_state was parseable (AM-4-4); omitted otherwise, never null — RM reads the absence as 'state unparseable' and must not burn its retry chain

message.$comment: deterministic English, no timestamps (VD-7). Frozen formats include strategy_execution_timeout:{YYYY-MM-DD} and strategy_execution_error:{YYYY-MM-DD}:{exception class} (VD-8/B1, Step 7). pt-v1.2 adds 'interval 5m is cn_a-only in pt-v1.2' and the cn_a session gate; pt-v1.3 adds the volume_share 5m/cn_a gate and 'order_volume_ratio requires fill_model=volume_share'.

request.title: paper_trade_step pt-v1.3 request additions (opt-in per-order volume share)

fill_model.$comment: pt-v1.3 adds 'volume_share': per-order partial fills capped by the order's own share of the matched volume. 'all_or_none' (the default, and the only value in pt-v1.1/pt-v1.2) keeps the existing behaviour byte-identical.

order_volume_ratio.$comment: Opt-in pt-v1.3 per-order share of available volume, 0 < r <= 1. Each order is capped independently (never a shared bar budget). Accepted ONLY with fill_model='volume_share'; a supplied ratio without it is INVALID_REQUEST. Omitted or null means 1.0 (no reduction).

request.$comment: Documents only the pt-v1.3 request additions. The authoritative request contract — every field, the orders/strategy_path exclusivity, the 5m cn_a-only gates and the ratio domain check — is schema.py::parse_request; this schema is never emitted in a result.
